profile.headline: Software Engineer at Twitch
profile.summary: Hi, my name is Jillian and I am a recent graduate of UC Berkeley. I studied Computer Science, and have specific interests in backend software development, user interface and design, and data science. I am also passionate about theater and dance!

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Front-end design and development for Emerging Technologies Group
• Used React & Redux to develop the user interface for Test Data Management
• 2nd place at IBM Internal Hackathon: Built OCR Mobile App to scan ingredient lists for environmentally harmful ingredients

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Created GrabShare micro-service to determine CO2 emissions saved by carpooling 
• Developed CO2 model based on research literature and implemented in Go on the Grab Platform 
• Defined new databases for CO2 data and built simulator to test emissions calculator on historical data

positions.title: CS Kickstart
positions.description:
• Computer science scholarship for women in STEM
• A hands-on programming introduction to computer science at Berkeley

positions.title: Retail Sales
positions.description:
• Worked in customer sales 
• Created in-store displays and assisted with in-store events

educations.fieldOfStudy: Computer Science; Minor, Theater and Dance
